verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents headless automation directly. Its REST API is called with an API key and lets you "automate management of models, deployments, datasets, and more". Model upload is explicitly described as "ideal for automation, CI/CD pipelines, and notebooks". The firectl CLI handles deployments and autoscaling configuration from single commands and flags. missing for 10: CI-specific integration guides (e.g. CI runner examples) beyond the model-upload page, documented non-interactive auth for firectl, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Fireworks REST API to upload custom models programmatically — ideal for automation, CI/CD pipelines, and notebooks.
It also lets you automate management of models, deployments, datasets, and more.
Deploy your LoRA trained model with a single command: firectl deployment create
Configure replica counts, scale-up/down windows, scale-to-zero, and load targets for on-demand Fireworks deployments using firectl flags.
